{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = sales_df[(sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check if any refunded orders are in this group
refunded_in_filtered = filtered_df[filtered_df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Refunded orders in NEW + PAID SEARCH group: {len(refunded_in_filtered)}")

# Count total orders and converted orders in this group
total_orders = len(filtered_df)
converted_orders = filtered_df['converted'].sum()

# Calculate fraction converted
fraction_converted = converted_orders / total_orders

print(f"Total NEW + PAID SEARCH orders: {total_orders}")
print(f"Converted NEW + PAID SEARCH orders: {converted_orders}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")

# Output the result as a fraction between 0 and 1
fraction_converted"}
